Title: AMD 2026 Q1 Preview (Historical Reconstruction)

This document is a historical reconstruction. It uses only public information available by February 3, 2026. It was not written before the Q1 2026 earnings release. It must not be read as a contemporary forecast.

Baseline (Q4 2025, released February 3, 2026):
- Revenue was a record $10.3 billion.
- GAAP gross margin was 54%. Non-GAAP gross margin was 57%.
- Non-GAAP operating income was $2.9 billion. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.53. Both were records.
- Data Center segment revenue was a record $5.4 billion, up 39% year over year.
- Client revenue was a record $3.1 billion, up 34%. Gaming revenue was $843 million, up 50%. Embedded revenue was $950 million, up 3%.
- Q4 included an MI308 inventory reserve release of about $360 million.
- Q4 also included about $390 million of MI308 revenue to China.
- Excluding those two items, Q4 non-GAAP gross margin was about 55%.
- Full-year 2025 revenue was $34.6 billion, up 34% year over year.

Guidance for Q1 2026:
- Revenue: about $9.8 billion, plus or minus $300 million.
- The midpoint implies growth of about 32% year over year and a decline of about 5% sequentially.
- MI308 sales to China: about $100 million.
- Non-GAAP gross margin: about 55%.

Core questions:
1. Can Data Center growth continue without one-time support? The reserve release and China sales boosted Q4. Q1 assumes much lower China MI308 revenue. The key is whether non-China Instinct and EPYC demand fills the gap.
2. Is 55% non-GAAP gross margin the sustainable level? The reported 57% included one-time items. The 55% guide matches the adjusted level. This is normalization, not deterioration.
3. Can Client and Gaming hold in a seasonally weak quarter? Q4 set records. CES 2026 products provide support.

Expectation gaps:
- Positive: record Data Center revenue; EPYC expansion at AWS; Embedded returned to growth; strong 2026 product roadmap (Helios, MI430X, MI440X); management cited record 2025 free cash flow.
- Negative: China MI308 revenue falls sharply; export-control uncertainty remains; gross margin guide is two points below Q4 reported; consumer seasonality; the reserve release will not repeat.

Verification points:
- Revenue versus the $9.8 billion midpoint and year-over-year growth of about 32%.
- Non-GAAP gross margin versus 55%; how the about-$100 million China MI308 revenue affects margin.
- Segment trends: Data Center sequential change; Client and Gaming seasonality; Embedded continuation.
- Non-GAAP operating income, net income, EPS; GAAP-to-adjusted differences (SBC, amortization, acquisition costs, discontinued operations).
- Free cash flow versus the record claim.

Analysis:
- No contemporaneous preview exists. This reconstruction does not include Q1 2026 actual results or any information after February 3, 2026.
- Next quarter points: China export-control policy and MI308 revenue; MI430X, MI440X and Helios adoption; gross margin sustainability at 55%; Embedded and Gaming trends; GAAP presentation after the ZT Systems manufacturing divestiture.
reader_questions: 问题1：上季非 GAAP 毛利率 57%、本季指引 55%，这 2 个百分点是否说明公司利润率在恶化？→ 已修改正文：明确 57% 含一次性提振（存货转回+中国区销售），剔除后约 55%，指引 55% 是回归常态而非恶化。
问题2：公司指引同比 +32% 是否因上季中国区高基数而高估了增长动能？→ 已修改正文：核心问题 1 明示中国区 MI308 由约 3.9 亿美元降至约 1 亿美元，公司未拆分非中国区 AI 收入，无法计算剔除后同比，并把它列为验证点。
问题3：ZT Systems 制造业务剥离产生的终止经营以及单季税项调整，会不会让 GAAP 净利润对比失真？→ 已修改正文：验证点加入 GAAP 与调整后口径差额及终止经营列报；结论不以 GAAP 单季净利同比为依据。
fact_checks: 日期与事件：2025Q4 业绩于 2026-02-03 公布，与资料元数据一致；本稿针对 2026Q1，未使用目标财报日 2026-05-05 之后的任何信息。
币种与单位：原文表格以百万美元计（如 $10,270M），正文统一折算为亿美元；GAAP/非 GAAP 口径分别标注。
Q4 2025：收入 102.7 亿≈103 亿美元（创纪录）；GAAP 毛利率 54%、非 GAAP 57%；GAAP 营业利润 17.5 亿、非 GAAP 28.5 亿；GAAP EPS 0.92、非 GAAP EPS 1.53——均与公告一致。
Q4 分部：数据中心 54 亿美元（+39%）、客户端 31 亿美元（+34%，创纪录）、游戏 8.43 亿美元（+50%）、嵌入式 9.5 亿美元（+3%）——均与公告一致。
2025 全年：收入 346 亿美元（+34%）、GAAP 毛利率 50%、非 GAAP 52%、GAAP EPS 2.65、非 GAAP EPS 4.17；含约 4.4 亿美元出口管制相关净计提——与公告一致。
2026Q1 指引：收入约 98 亿±3 亿美元；中位同比约 +32%、环比约 -5%（由 98/102.7 推算约 -4.6%，公司表述为约 -5%）；含约 1 亿美元中国区 MI308；非 GAAP 毛利率约 55%——均与公告一致。
一次性项目：Q4 约 3.6 亿美元 MI308 存货转回、约 3.9 亿美元中国区 MI308 收入；公司称剔除后非 GAAP 毛利率约 55%。调整后非 GAAP 毛利表为 54.25 亿美元，需配合分母剔除中国区收入才得约 55%；正文只引公司口径。
共识与股价：所附来源不含分析师范共识或财报后股价，正文未编造此类数字。
推论标签：“增长延续、利润率回归常态”“AI 需求继续扩张”为本稿判断，非公司指引原文；“无同期 Preview”为事实判断。
Analysis：明确标注不存在同期 Preview，未事后补写 2026Q1 实际结果，未使用 2026-02-03 之后信息。
